scenario: It is a slow Friday afternoon and Kate starts a game: 'If you could change one thing, what would you do?' The whole episode is second conditional and wishes. Pol says, 'If I could work from anywhere, I would live by the sea and do yoga every morning.' Alex says, 'If I had a quiet room, I would sleep all day — I have four kids!' Den says, 'If I were the boss, nobody would touch my mug.' Peter says, 'If I weren't so shy, I would sing at the party.' Valery says, 'If it were up to me, we would all finish at five.' Kate dreams too: 'If we won a big project, I would take everyone to the sea.' A few wishes slip in: 'I wish I had a bigger desk', 'If only it were Friday every day.' Warm, funny daydreaming; nobody actually changes anything. Use clear second conditionals ('If + past, would + verb') and 'I wish / if only + past'. Short B1 sentences.
